commission: Assess mentoring access (X) and promotion (Y) in this synthetic organizational population. The requested quantity is the average causal risk difference E[Y(1)] minus E[Y(0)], if identified by the supplied evidence. table_meaning: Exact population probability weights, not a finite sample. Divide weights by their sum to obtain the joint population distribution. There is no sampling-error or confidence-interval question.
